//: Example .claude/settings.local.json for nvim-mcp 'enforce' mode. Denies the built-in Bash tool so ALL shell goes through Neovim's nvim_run_in_terminal, the way Cursor's agent runs commands inside the editor. The deny-bash hook gives the agent a helpful message pointing it at the right tool. Requires the nvim-mcp-hook bin on PATH (npm i -g nvim-mcp) or change the command to an npx form. The :ClaudeCode plugin generates this for you.
